measurement_boundary: complete backend flow plus JSON encode/decode; no HTTP, session/auth middleware, RTK or browser
cold_definition: Django cache aliases cleared before each sample; fresh calculation request contexts; Python/schema/OS/SQLite buffers already initialized
warm_definition: Django caches cleared once, one untimed warmup, then five repeats; fresh calculation request contexts
sample_dispersion_note: IQR and range describe observed dispersion, not a confidence interval. Two fresh processes per variant, five samples per mode per process.
